error.name: PrismaClientKnownRequestError
error.message: Transaction API error: A batch query cannot be executed on an expired transaction. The timeout for this transaction was 10000 ms, however 13713 ms passed since the start of the transaction. Consider increasing the interactive transaction timeout or doing less work in the transaction.
